result.summary: The layout is largely coherent, but there are a few visual inconsistencies: truncated restaurant name without ellipsis in the 'Fastest near you' carousel, inconsistent favorite (heart) button styling between cards, and an inconsistent image treatment on one carousel thumbnail. Bottom content is clipped by the tab bar with no visible scroll affordance.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the third card's title is hard-cut at the screen edge ('Trattoria Piccol') and its subtitle ('€1.90 delivery') is also clipped, with no ellipsis to indicate truncation.
issues.suggestion: Apply text truncation with ellipsis constrained to the card width, and add horizontal padding/peek so partially visible cards clearly indicate scrollability rather than looking cut off.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently: the Tokumaru Ramen card uses a white circular button with a dark outline heart, while the pizza card below uses a dark/translucent circle with a white heart.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button to a single background and icon treatment across all cards, or make it dependent only on state (favorited vs not), not on the card.

issues.description: The 'Green Bowl Poké' thumbnail has a light gray background while the sibling cards use dark, vignetted imagery, making the row look visually unbalanced.
issues.suggestion: Normalize image backgrounds/overlays across carousel thumbnails (e.g. apply the same gradient scrim) so cards appear consistent.

issues.description: The pizza card in 'Popular right now' is abruptly clipped by the bottom tab bar with only the image visible and no title/metadata, giving the impression of broken content.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding equal to the tab bar height so the last card is fully reachable, and consider snapping/spacing so partial cards look intentional.

issues.description: Delivery time badges and secondary metadata (e.g. '€0.90 delivery', '25–35 min') use light gray text on white, which may fall below recommended contrast ratios.
issues.suggestion: Darken secondary text color to meet at least 4.5:1 contrast, and ensure icon-only buttons (bell, heart) have accessible labels.
